name: task_board
description: Relay: JIRA for AI Agents. Create a local, structured development board with tasks, priorities, dependencies, blockers, acceptance criteria, comments, activity history, and ready-work summaries. Writes require confirm_write=true.

action.description: Read-only: list, get, summary, review_ticket, resume_ticket. Writes require confirm_write=true. Organize tickets and Epics into Relay boards, then record execution, handoffs, Git evidence, validations, artifacts, and project decisions.

path.description: Absolute or relative path to the local Relay JSON file.

filters.description: Optional list filters: status, priority, assignee, label, parent_id, or ready.

task.description: Ticket for add on the selected Relay board. Supports title, description, priority, type (including epic), assignee, labels, sprint, parent_id, dependencies, acceptance criteria, blockers, artifacts, and workspace_id. Set parent_id to attach a ticket to an Epic in the same board.

issue.description: Bug-ticket payload for log_issue. Uses the same fields as task and defaults type to bug.

id.description: Task id for get, update, transition, comment, or archive.

changes.description: Non-status task fields to change with update. Use transition for status changes.

reason.description: Optional transition or archive rationale stored in task history.

comment.description: Comment body for action=comment. Relay records its UTC timestamp.

sprint.description: Sprint name for assign_sprint, or include it on a ticket payload.

related_id.description: Existing ticket id to link with action=link_issue.

project.description: Project metadata for set_project: name, description, repository, or updated_by.

allow_incomplete_dependencies.description: Allow a task to transition to done while dependencies are incomplete.

confirm_write.description: Must be true for add, update, transition, comment, archive, and set_project.

agent.description: Agent identity for claiming or starting a ticket.

checkpoint.description: Optional local checkpoint reference attached to an agent run.

note.description: Required handoff note describing work, evidence, and next step.

repo_path.description: Local Git repository path for attach_git_evidence.

base_ref.description: Optional Git ref used to calculate changed files and diff stat.

validation_kind.description: Validation category, such as test, lint, build, or review.

artifact_label.description: Human-readable label for a linked local artifact.

artifact_reference.description: Artifact path, URL, commit, or other local reference.

source.description: Finding source for create_from_finding, such as test_runner or dependency_audit.

epic.description: Epic payload for plan_epic; supports the same fields as task except type is always epic.

session_id.description: Control-plane session identifier linked to a handoff and agent run.

agent_client.description: Optional local CLI used for a handoff.

working_directory.description: Optional local working directory provided to a launched agent.

workspace_source.description: Workspace source for a terminal handoff.

repository_url.description: Remote Git URL cloned into a fresh workspace when no local directory is supplied.

branch_rules.description: Optional branch naming, commit, lint, test, and review rules passed to the agent harness.

workspace_id.description: Workspace assigned to a ticket, targeted for deletion, or updated.

workspace.description: Workspace for add_workspace or update_workspace: name, source (local or remote), local_directory, repository_url, and branch_rules.

board_id.description: Relay board id. Omit for the default board. Tickets, Epics, summaries, and board actions are scoped to this board.

board.description: Board payload for add_board or update_board: name (required for add), optional description, and accent color.

planning_brief.description: Initial project brief captured when a gated Relay AI Task Planner session is launched.
